issues.detail: Example expected q=1,2,3 from reset=0 rows implies starting from 0, but no rule defines initial value or that q increments from prior state; contradicts R1 example ending at q=0 then R2 starting at 1 without transition.
Example shows ena=1 on third row but condition q[3:0]==9 not established by prior rows; ena bit position (which of ena[2:0]) unspecified.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: Example ena values 0,1,3 inconsistent with R3 (ena=1 for tens) and bit encoding unclear; 3 implies two bits set simultaneously.
Example ena 0,3,7 inconsistent with R3/R4 and no bit mapping defined for ena[2:0].
Example q=9,16,17: 16 is not valid BCD (tens digit 1, ones 6) but transition from 9 to 16 skips 10-15 and 16->17 increments ones only; contradicts BCD counter semantics.
ena bit mapping to digits [3:1] unspecified; could be ena[0]=tens,ena[1]=hundreds,ena[2]=thousands or reversed.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: ena timing: whether enable indicates increment on same edge (combinational from current q) or registered output; rules say same_cycle but examples ambiguous.
issues.alternative: ena registered one cycle after q[3:0]==9

issues.detail: R1 example expected q=0,ena=0 on reset=1 rows but no verbatim spec states reset value is zero; spec only says synchronous active-high reset.
Increment condition for ones digit unspecified (always increment vs only when not rolling over); affects whether q[3:0] wraps 9->0.
issues.alternative: ones digit increments every cycle including 9->0 wrap

issues.detail: No rule covers carry propagation to tens/hundreds/thousands digits (increment of upper digits when enabled); only ena outputs defined.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.
